issues.description: Method getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): problem statement UML declares the method should return double, but the solution implementation declares it as returning int. The problem statement (UML) shows getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double, while solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Lecture.java defines public int getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(). This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and lead to failing tests or incorrect implementations if students follow the UML (double) while the reference uses int.
